Howon · Listen & Shadow 05

Reading the Room
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · READING PEOPLE
👤 Brian
What's she like with people?
그 사람은 어떤 식이에요?
be like with people — 사람 대하는 방식이 ~하다
💬 Howon
Now that I'm thinking about it, she treats people better when they're not being nice to her.
지금 생각해 보니까, 자기한테 잘 안 해주는 사람한테 오히려 더 잘해줘요.
now that I'm thinking about it — 지금 생각해 보니 · treat — 대하다
같은 패턴으로 — Now that I'm thinking about it, he never called back. · Now that I think about it, that was the first sign.
💬 Howon
There will be a rumor — people will catch the drift.
소문이 날 거예요. 사람들이 눈치챌 거예요.
rumor — 소문 · catch the drift — 눈치채다, 대충 알아듣다
같은 패턴으로 — I think he caught the drift. · There's already a rumor going around.
💬 Howon
You have to read the room.
분위기를 읽어야죠.
read the room — 분위기를 파악하다
같은 패턴으로 — He never reads the room. · Read the room before you make a joke.
💬 Howon
I dislike him even more now.
그 사람이 더 싫어졌어요.
dislike — 싫어하다 · even more — 더욱
같은 패턴으로 — I like her even more now. · That made me trust him even less.
💬 Howon
I feel bad for him, but there's a sketchiness about him.
안됐다는 생각은 드는데, 어딘가 수상한 데가 있어요.
feel bad for — 안쓰럽게 여기다 · sketchy — 수상한 (sketchiness — 수상한 느낌)
같은 패턴으로 — I feel bad for her, but she brought it on herself. · There's something sketchy about that offer.
💬 Howon
I can build up my body well.
저는 몸을 잘 만드는 편이에요.
build up — 만들다, 키우다
같은 패턴으로 — He built up his body for the role. · It takes years to build up that kind of stamina.
💬 Howon
He's pretty thick-skinned.
그 사람은 낯이 두꺼워요.
thick-skinned — 낯이 두꺼운, 비판에 끄떡없는
같은 패턴으로 — You have to be thick-skinned in this industry. · She's too thin-skinned for the comments section.
PART 2 · ON SET
👤 Brian
What happened with the hair and make-up team?
헤어 메이크업 팀하고 무슨 일이 있었어요?
hair and make-up — 헤어·메이크업 (팀)
💬 Howon
I wanted to tell her something lightly.
가볍게 말하고 싶었던 거예요.
lightly — 가볍게
같은 패턴으로 — I mentioned it lightly, as a joke. · Don't take it lightly.
💬 Howon
I didn't see any sincere feeling when she said it.
그렇게 말할 때 진심이 안 보였어요.
sincere — 진심의
같은 패턴으로 — I didn't see any effort from him. · There was no sincerity in her apology.
💬 Howon
The hair and make-up artist isn't accommodating enough.
헤어 메이크업 담당이 융통성이 별로 없어요.
accommodating — 맞춰주는, 융통성 있는
같은 패턴으로 — The hotel staff were very accommodating. · He's not accommodating when it comes to schedule changes.
💬 Howon
I just needed an additional touch on my hair — a small adjustment.
머리를 조금만 더 손봐 달라는 거였어요. 살짝만요.
additional touch — 한 번 더 손보기 · adjustment — 조정
같은 패턴으로 — The scene needs one more touch. · Just a small adjustment to the collar.
💬 Howon
Supporting actors have to read the room all the time.
조연은 늘 주연 눈치를 봐요.
supporting actor — 조연 · all the time — 늘
같은 패턴으로 — Supporting actors end up walking on eggshells around the leads. · We're constantly gauging the lead's mood.
💬 Howon
You end up watching what you say around the leads.
주연 앞에서는 말조심하게 돼요.
watch what you say — 말조심하다 · the lead — 주연
같은 패턴으로 — I watch what I say around the director. · You end up second-guessing every choice you make.
💬 Howon
Someone has to take one for the team.
누군가는 팀을 위해 참아야죠.
take one for the team — 팀을 위해 희생하다 (= hold it for everyone)
같은 패턴으로 — I took one for the team and did the night shoot. · Thanks for taking one for the team.
💬 Howon
I might as well give it a go.
해볼 만하잖아요. 그냥 해보는 거죠.
might as well — ~하는 편이 낫다 · give it a go — 한번 해보다
같은 패턴으로 — We might as well stay for the whole thing. · Give it a go — what's the worst that could happen?
💬 Howon
She keeps bugging me — she's a bit of an attention seeker.
자꾸 저를 귀찮게 해요. 관심받고 싶어 하는 사람이에요.
bug — 귀찮게 하다 · attention seeker — 관심받고 싶어 하는 사람
같은 패턴으로 — My brother keeps bugging me about the car. · He's a bit of a perfectionist.
💬 Howon
That's just my personal interpretation.
그건 그냥 제 개인적인 해석이에요.
interpretation — 해석
같은 패턴으로 — That's just my take on it. · Everyone had a different interpretation of the ending.
💬 Howon
It was a sense of crisis for us — he was trying to make himself look scary.
위기감이 있었어요. 그 사람이 일부러 무섭게 보이려고 했거든요.
sense of crisis — 위기감 (= sense of urgency) · make oneself look ~ — 일부러 ~해 보이게 하다
같은 패턴으로 — There's a real sense of urgency now. · He makes himself look busier than he is.
💬 Howon
Her eyes welled up.
눈물이 글썽했어요.
well up — 글썽이다 (= tear up)
같은 패턴으로 — I teared up at the ending. · His eyes welled up when he saw the letter.
💬 Howon
I was stunned — like, what just happened?
벙쪘어요. 이게 무슨 일인가 싶었어요.
stunned — 어안이 벙벙한 · what just happened? — 방금 무슨 일이지?
같은 패턴으로 — I was dumbfounded. · I just stood there like, what?
💬 Howon
It caught me off guard.
허를 찔렸어요.
catch ~ off guard — 허를 찌르다, 예상 못 하게 하다
같은 패턴으로 — The question caught me off guard. · Don't let them catch you off guard.
PART 3 · AT THE OFFICE
👤 Brian
How did it go at the company?
회사에서는 어땠어요?
how did it go — 어땠어요
💬 Howon
I didn't have the headspace back then.
그때는 여유가 없었어요.
headspace — 마음의 여유 · back then — 그때는
같은 패턴으로 — I don't have the headspace for this right now. · I was stretched thin back then.
💬 Howon
I had no bandwidth for anything else.
다른 걸 할 여력이 전혀 없었어요.
bandwidth — (일을 더 받을) 여력
같은 패턴으로 — I don't have the bandwidth to take that on. · She's got no bandwidth this month.
💬 Howon
He wasn't fitting in well, and he's hard to get along with.
그 사람은 잘 적응을 못했고, 같이 지내기도 어려운 사람이에요.
fit in — 적응하다, 어울리다 · get along with — 잘 지내다
같은 패턴으로 — It took me a year to fit in. · She's easy to get along with.
💬 Howon
He's a bit insecure about it.
그 사람은 그런 데 좀 열등감이 있어요.
insecure — 자신 없는, 열등감 있는 (= inferiority complex)
같은 패턴으로 — I'm insecure about my accent. · He's got an inferiority complex about his background.
💬 Howon
He's got a chip on his shoulder.
자격지심이 있어서 쉽게 발끈해요.
a chip on one's shoulder — 자격지심 (쉽게 발끈하는)
같은 패턴으로 — He's had a chip on his shoulder since he got passed over. · She takes everything personally.
💬 Howon
They keep each other in check.
서로 견제해요.
keep ~ in check — 견제하다, 못 커지게 누르다
같은 패턴으로 — The two leads keep each other in check. · They were sizing each other up all day.
💬 Howon
He sees me as a threat.
그 사람은 저를 위협으로 봐요.
see ~ as a threat — ~를 위협으로 여기다 · undercut — 깎아내리다
같은 패턴으로 — She saw the new hire as a threat. · He kept trying to undercut me in meetings.
💬 Howon
There was a power struggle between the two leads.
두 주연 사이에 기싸움이 있었어요.
power struggle — 기싸움, 주도권 다툼 (= battle of egos)
같은 패턴으로 — It turned into a battle of egos. · There's always a power struggle on a big set.
💬 Howon
They kept trying to one-up each other.
서로 한 수 위라는 걸 보여주려고 했어요.
one-up — 한 수 위임을 보이다 · jockey for position — 자리다툼하다
같은 패턴으로 — Stop trying to one-up me. · Everyone was jockeying for position after the shake-up.
💬 Howon
I try to keep the mood light and sense things early.
저는 분위기를 가볍게 가져가고, 미리 눈치를 채는 편이에요.
keep the mood light — 분위기를 가볍게 유지하다 · sense — 감지하다
같은 패턴으로 — He's good at keeping the mood light. · I sensed something was off right away.
💬 Howon
It's tax deductible — we put it under the year-end party.
그건 세금 공제가 돼요. 연말 회식으로 처리했어요.
tax deductible — 세금 공제되는 · year-end party — 연말 회식 · put ~ under — ~ 명목으로 처리하다
같은 패턴으로 — Is this expense tax deductible? · Put it under travel.
💬 Howon
I did a wire transfer and they charged a fee.
송금했는데 수수료를 물더라고요.
wire transfer — 송금 · charge a fee — 수수료를 받다
같은 패턴으로 — They charged a fee for the withdrawal. · I got a preferential rate because of my account.
